requirements.requirement: The system must define a Pydantic model representing a weighting schema with measure_id and weight fields.
The system must support a default weighting configuration where all measures have predefined weights.
The system must allow user-provided weights to override default weights on a per-measure basis.
The system must validate that all weights are numeric values within an allowed range (e.g., 0 to 1 or 0 to 100).
The system must validate that the sum of all weights meets a normalization rule (e.g., equals 1.0 or is normalizable).
The system must return a normalized weighting schema when user-provided weights do not sum to the expected total but are otherwise valid.
The system must reject weighting inputs containing unknown or unsupported measure_id values.
The system must expose an input contract for weights that can be serialized to and from JSON.
The system must expose an output contract that includes both effective weights and metadata indicating default vs overridden values.
The system must provide deterministic validation results for identical weight inputs.
The system must fail validation when any weight value is missing for a required measure and no default exists.
The system must fallback to default weights when user-provided weights are null or empty.
The system must generate a complete weighting schema covering all required measures after applying overrides and defaults.
The system must ensure the weighting schema is compatible with downstream scoring engine input requirements.
The system must, when using an LLM to assist in weight suggestion, ensure the generated weights conform to the same validation rules as user input.
The system must, when using an LLM, produce weight outputs in the defined Pydantic schema format without requiring post-hoc structural correction.
The system must, when using an LLM, reject or reprocess outputs that contain non-numeric or malformed weight values.
The system must, when using an LLM, ensure that all required measures are present in the generated weighting schema.
The system must, when using an LLM, ensure consistent weight outputs for identical prompts and inputs within a defined tolerance.
The system must, when using an LLM, provide traceable metadata indicating whether weights were user-defined, default, or LLM-generated.
